channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: China Plans to Strengthen AI Token Standards in Computing Push
item.description: China’s National Data Administration will improve standards on the measurement and billing of artificial intelligence tokens and quality assessment, as Beijing guides the development of the growing industry.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: How AI Is Reshaping China's Industrial Policy
item.description: Can Chinese tech companies help the country achieve technological self-reliance while keeping up in the AI arms race? On this episode, we speak with Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution’s John L. Thornton China Center and author of the High Capacity newsletter, about Beijing’s response to the global AI boom and the tensions between Chinese companies’ commercial ambitions and the government’s long-term plans. He explains how companies draw on shared expertise and supply chains to expand across industries including smartphones, robotics, EVs and semiconductors — and we also discuss Huawei’s efforts to compete with Nvidia and why technological success doesn’t necessarily translate into strong returns for stock investors in China. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Taiwan Widens Short Sale Curbs After Shares Plunge on AI Concern
item.description: Taiwan widened curbs on short sales of local stocks and said it has been buying shares, stepping up efforts to revive confidence after the island’s benchmark index had its worst weekly fall in 35 years.
item.dc:creator: Betty Hou

item.title: China Deploys 5G Across Manufacturing Base as 6G Testing Advances, CCTV Reports
item.description: China is expanding the use of 5G across its manufacturing sector, with more than 26,000 private industrial 5G networks built nationwide, China Central Television said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Anthropic Researcher Claims to Solve Riemann Problem With Claude
item.description: On the heels of Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering, a researcher at the company said he believes he used its artificial intelligence software to solve a famous number theory problem that has plagued mathematicians for more than 150 years.
item.dc:creator: Elena Eisenstadt and Rachel Metz

item.title: Wall Street Week | Gaming Blockbuster, Healthcare Costs, Cybersecurity Meets AI
item.description: This week, former New York Fed President Bill Dudley and Kathryn Judge of Columbia Law School discuss what the Treasury and Fed can do to tackle the nation’s debt crisis. Plus, what Grand Theft Auto 6’s release means for a video game industry that routinely faces layoffs, delays and slowing consumer spending. Later, surging healthcare costs affect businesses and their employees as Americans choose their insurance policies for the year ahead. And, how is AI changing the cybersecurity stakes for small businesses? (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Tony Wang on CrowdStrike-Zscaler Deal, AI Trade
item.description: Tony Wang, Portfolio Manager of the Science and Technology Equity Strategy at T. Rowe Price, is asked whether the AI cycle has changed and whether recent declines create a buying opportunity. He also flags Wednesday’s PCE inflation report as a potential catalyst for markets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Wonder Explores Sale of Delivery Service Grubhub, WSJ Reports
item.description: Grubhub owner Wonder is considering a sale of the food-delivery business, the Wall Street Journal reported, adding to a wave of dealmaking in the sector.
item.dc:creator: Nick Turner

item.title: Hindlian Advisory CEO on AI & Anthropic Market Sell-off
item.description: Amanda Hindlian, Founder and CEO of Hindlian Advisory and Former Global Head of Capital Markets at the New York Stock Exchange, says Anthropic’s IPO should be judged separately from a volatile week for markets. She notes that investors had been uncertain about the pricing and overall execution just two weeks earlier, but the offering priced well, drew a significantly oversubscribed book—estimated at five to seven times—and traded strongly on its first day. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith on AI Usage in the Workplace
item.description: Jennifer Smith, Co-Founder and CEO of Scribe and a former Consultant at McKinsey, discusses AI valuations to adoption, noting research that puts AI use for workplace tasks below 4%. She says the findings contrast with the widespread chatbot and AI use they observe in their own circle. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto’ Drives Internet Providers to Record Usage
item.description: Record demand for the hot new video game Grand Theft Auto VI sent US internet traffic soaring this week.
item.dc:creator: Kelcee Griffis

item.title: Victor Peng Sees AI, Quantum Computing as Long-Term Opportunities
item.description: Victor Peng, CEO of PsiQuantum and former Advanced Micro Devices president, says quantum computing and optical switching could lower compute costs on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
item.description: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gould and David Carnevali

item.title: Anthropic CEO Vacations at Italian Resort After Public Listing
item.description: Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei is vacationing at a luxury resort in the south of Italy after completing a blockbuster initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Daniele Lepido and Tiago Ramos Alfaro

item.title: JPMorgan Gets Lowballed Below 80 Cents for Qualtrics Hung Debt
item.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is fielding rock-bottom offers from investors as it weighs a potential debt sale tied to an acquisition by Qualtrics International Inc.
item.dc:creator: Reshmi Basu and Gowri Gurumurthy

item.title: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
item.description: Artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after announcing its most recent funding round, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Torrence

item.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Sells $3.79 Billion, Making It Biggest Entertainment Launch Ever
item.description: The best-reviewed game ever is also the fastest-selling
item.dc:creator: Jason Schreier

item.title: US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets
item.description: Measures of perceived US credit risk reached levels not seen in nearly eight months and the cost of protecting the debt of some of the biggest tech firms against default jumped on Friday, as the wobbling AI trade spurred volatility in global markets and sent investors piling into safe havens.
item.dc:creator: Caleb Mutua and Emily Graffeo

item.title: Wall Street Reels as AI Fears Erupt; Nasdaq 100 Near Bear Market
item.description: Wall Street reeled on Friday as nagging concerns about the AI trade, which propelled US stocks from one high to the next for much of the year, turned into a full-blown, market-wide selloff. Anthropic PBC slumped after soaring in its public-market debut, while Nvidia Corp. sank 14%, pushing the Nasdaq 100 to the brink of a bear market.
item.dc:creator: Judy Lagrou and Geoffrey Morgan

item.title: Emerging Stocks Enter Bear Market as AI Triggers Global Selloff
item.description: The MSCI emerging-market stock index entered a bear market Friday, declining for a seventh day, the longest losing streak since 2024, amid a selloff in global tech shares.
item.dc:creator: Ray Ndlovu, Prima Wirayani and Nicolle Yapur
